map.比较不同本金/利率/期限下等额本息的月供、总利息和还款总额。: Compare monthly payment, total interest and total cost of equal-installment loans under different principal/rate/term.
map.按月供 M = P·i·(1+i)ⁿ/((1+i)ⁿ−1) 逐方案计算；总成本: Compute each plan by monthly payment M = P·i·(1+i)ⁿ/((1+i)ⁿ−1); total cost = monthly payment × periods + all fees
map.对多个贷款方案分别按等额本息计算月供、总利息与总费用并横向对比，用于贷款方案选型: For multiple loan plans, compute each plan's monthly payment, total interest and total cost by equal-installment and compare side by side, for loan-plan selection and negotiation reference.
map.横向对比多组贷款方案的月供与总利息: Compare multiple loan plans' monthly payment and total interest side by side
map.评估利率、期限变化对总成本的影响: Assess the impact of rate and term changes on total cost
map.贷款选型前找出总成本最低的方案: Before plan selection, find the lowest-total-cost option
map.同等金额下 20 年月供更高但总利息更少；页面并列展示月供与总成本，便于权衡现金: At the same amount, 20-year has higher monthly but less total interest; the page shows monthly and total cost side by side, easing the trade-off between cash flow and total outlay.
map.只看月供高低够吗？: Is comparing monthly payment alone enough?
map.不够。低月供常来自更长期限，总利息反而更高，应同时比较总还款额与总利息。: No. A low monthly often comes from a longer term, with higher total interest; compare total repayment and total interest together.
map.利率和费率有什么区别？: What is the difference between rate and fee rate?
map.利率按期计息，费率常按本金一次性收取（如手续费率），后者的实际年化成本通常高于表: Rate accrues by period; a fee rate is often charged once on principal (e.g. a handling fee), whose real annualized cost usually exceeds the surface number.
